# Bookmark.cards

> A self-hostable, open-source bookmark manager built with PHP and Kirby CMS. Users can save, tag, search, and export URLs. A free tier allows up to 12 bookmarks; a paid Premium tier removes that limit.

## What it does

- Stores bookmarks (URL + title + tags) per registered user
- Filters bookmarks by tag or searches by title, URL, or tag
- Detects duplicate URLs when adding a new bookmark
- Displays bookmarks as cards; if the title contains a known brand name, the card background uses that brand's visual style
- Exports bookmarks as JSON or CSV
- Works offline via a service worker (UpUp.js) that caches the bookmark list locally

## Tech stack

- **Backend**: PHP, [Kirby CMS](https://getkirby.com/) (flat-file, no database)
- **Payments**: Stripe via the kirby-memberkit plugin
- **Frontend**: Vanilla JS, Pico CSS (bundled), PostCSS for build
- **Analytics**: Pirsch (privacy-friendly, no cookies)
- **Testing**: Cypress (end-to-end: register, login, delete)
- **CI**: GitHub Actions (submodule updates, CSS regeneration, changelog)

## Repository structure

- `site/` — Kirby CMS application (controllers, templates, snippets, blueprints, config, plugins)
- `content/` — Flat-file content (home page, user accounts)
- `assets/` — Compiled CSS (including brand CSS) and JS
- `cypress/` — End-to-end test specs
- `.github/workflows/` — Automation: brand-names submodule updates, CSS generation, changelog

## Key design decisions

- Flat-file storage: content is stored as `.txt` files by Kirby; there is no relational database
- Brand backgrounds are CSS-only: a brand name token in the bookmark title triggers a CSS class; no server-side image processing at render time
- No social or collaborative features by design
- Free tier capped at 12 bookmarks (configurable via `noPremiumLimit` in `site/config/config.php`)
